shortDescription: UKPSC Combined State Civil Upper Subordinate Service Exam 2026 notification released for 67 posts. Apply online from 09 September 2026 to 29 September 2026.
content:
Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC) has released the notification for the Combined State Civil Upper Subordinate Service Examination 2026 under Advt. No. A-1/E-1/2026-27.

Important dates

  • Application begins: 09 September 2026
  • Last date to apply and pay fee: 29 September 2026
  • Correction window: 07 to 16 October 2026
  • Preliminary examination: As per schedule
  • Admit card: Before the examination

Vacancy and eligibility

The recruitment has 67 Combined State Civil Upper Subordinate Service vacancies. Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree in any stream from a recognized university. Check the official advertisement for service-wise eligibility and other conditions.

How to apply

Complete the application through the UKPSC portal during the application period. Read the advertisement, complete OTR if required, fill in the form, pay the fee and retain the submitted application for future use.
